meta.name: RPSGT Visual Skills Engine prototype sleep-staging pack
meta.copyrightBoundary: Deterministic schematic teaching signals only. No external PSG recording, scoring-manual figure, textbook figure, or third-party waveform is embedded.
meta.clinicalBoundary: Prototype recognition content only. It does not reproduce or replace current official scoring criteria or supervised scorer training.

questions.prompt: Which sleep stage is this schematic epoch designed to represent?
questions.rationale: This app-authored teaching epoch intentionally includes an N2-oriented EEG pattern with a prominent K-complex and sleep-spindle region. Use current official guidance for actual scoring criteria.

questions.prompt: Select the time region containing the sleep-spindle teaching feature in C3-M2.
questions.rationale: The schematic spindle burst is centered near 14 seconds. This is a teaching signal, not a copied clinical epoch.

questions.prompt: Select the time region containing the K-complex teaching feature in C3-M2.
questions.rationale: The schematic K-complex is centered near 9 seconds. The region-selection interaction is intentionally coarse in this first prototype; free-coordinate marking can be added later.
